title: I Trained an AI to Fight a Giant Bug (It Went Horribly)
description:
He had never walked. The bug had never fought. Neither one was told how. Then they fought 845 times.

Everything here is real physics. The AI learned every move by trial and error: walking, kicking, getting up, even standing still. Then the bug got a brain too, and it learned to fight back.

Final score: 845 fights. He won 3.
